We focus on developing market applications for the cereal crop oats (Avena sativa) from food through to cosmetic applications. Consultancy Leveraging decades of in-depth knowledge, Oat Services Ltd. have provided expert consultancy services to government agencies and private enterprises, guiding the exploration and development of the oat crop for novel applications. Applications Our patented technologies have enabled us to successfully integrate oat-derived solutions into advanced food products, enhancing the performance of disposable gloves, and creating revolutionary ingredients for the cosmetics industry.
